title: Daily Temperatures
description: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices: pop while the new temp is warmer, recording the wait for each popped index.

notes: Stack stores INDICES, not temperatures — you need the index to compute i - j.
Strict greater-than (>) keeps the stack monotonically decreasing.
Indices left on the stack at the end have no warmer day — they keep their initial 0.

options: O(n) — each index pushed and popped at most once

questions.q: Why initialize the result array with zeros?
options: Indices with no warmer day to the right keep 0 by default

exercises.prompt: Fill in the monotonic-stack solution for daily temperatures.

blanks.hint: default wait for an index with no warmer day
take the top off the stack
days waited = i minus popped index

L3.prompt: Write `dailyTemperatures(temps)` returning an array where result[i] is days until a warmer temperature (0 if none). Log `JSON.stringify(dailyTemperatures([73, 74, 75, 71, 69, 72, 76, 73]))`.
hints: Keep a stack of INDICES whose answer is still pending.
On a warmer temp, pop and record i - j.
